2609.32787.title: CLAIRE: A Schema-Grounded Hybrid Workflow for Healthcare Administrative Form Completion
2609.32787.paper_summary: Healthcare administrative staff transfer structured information from electronic health records, referrals, claims systems, provider rosters, and work queues into dynamic forms. We developed and evaluated CLAIRE (Clinical Language and Agentic Intelligence for Reasoning and Entry), a hybrid workflow that separates field-state discovery, source-to-field mapping, deterministic validation, bounded correction, escalation, and audit tracing. We tested five synthetic healthcare administrative schemas, 1,000 source records, four interface variants, two data-quality suites, and six comparators, yielding 24,000 benchmark episodes. A separate strict-output audit evaluated direct mappings from Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B, and a trace-derived operational simulation covered 6,000 episodes. Under the evaluated synthetic benchmark conditions, full CLAIRE achieved 1.000 episode success, field accuracy, required-field completion, and dependency completion in both suites; removing validation reduced stress-suite success to 0.500. In the simulation, 100.0% of clean and validation-stress episodes reached a staff-reviewable draft, compared with 68.6% of escalation challenge episodes, unsupported cases were blocked. Scenario-based savings were 149.7-165.5 seconds per case, not observed staff times. The findings support schema-grounded, validation-first healthcare administrative automation in which language-model components assist mapping but do not authorize unsupported or consequential actions.
2609.32787.paper_summary_zh: 醫療行政人員將電子健康紀錄、轉診、索賠系統、提供者名單和工作隊列中的結構化資訊轉移到動態表單中。 我們開發並評估了CLAIRE（臨床語言與代理智慧推理與輸入），這是一種混合工作流程，將領域狀態發現、源到領域映射、確定性驗證、有限修正、升級和審計追蹤分開。 我們測試了五個合成的醫療行政架構、1,000個源紀錄、四個介面變體、兩個數據質量套件和六個比較器，產生了24,000個基準事件。 一個獨立的嚴格輸出審計評估了來自Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-7B的直接映射，並且一個基於追蹤的操作模擬涵蓋了6,000個事件。 在評估的合成基準條件下，完整的CLAIRE在兩個套件中實現了1.000的事件成功率、領域準確性、所需領域完成率和依賴性完成率；去除驗證將壓力套件的成功率降低到0.500。 在模擬中，100.0%的清潔和驗證壓力事件達到了可供人員審查的草稿，而升級挑戰事件的比例為68.6%，不支持的案例被阻止。 基於情境的節省為每個案例149.7-165.5秒，未觀察到的工作時間。 這些發現支持基於架構的、優先驗證的醫療行政自動化，其中語言模型組件協助映射，但不授權不支持或有後果的行動。
2609.32787.author: Garapati Keerthana et.al.
